state.task: Render a complete original 32 by 32 pixel-art image. Each question asks you to choose the actual final palette color of exactly one pixel. All pixels belong to the same image.
state.image: A luminous alien jellyfish floating in a black ocean. A curved translucent cyan bell with a small warm amber glow inside, long thin curling cyan tentacles, and generous black negative space around the animal. One centered jellyfish seen from the front. Crisp pixel art with a recognizable silhouette. No text, frame, chart, or diagram.

canvas.coordinates: Integer pixel coordinates: x=0 is the left edge, x=31 is the right edge; y=0 is the top edge, y=31 is the bottom edge. Pixels are square.
